ios.desc:
Banana for Scale lets you place a realistic AR banana into the real world, making it the easiest and funniest way to show scale in photos.

Use augmented reality to drop a 3D banana anywhere using your camera. Simply point at a surface, tap to place, and instantly see how big something really is.

Need precise measurements? Use the built-in ruler to measure distances in centimeters alongside your banana reference for extra clarity.

Capture AR photos, add captions, and share instantly. Whether you’re showing off a new gadget, measuring a space, or just having fun, Banana for Scale turns the internet’s favorite size reference into a practical AR tool.
